results.note: empty-span (pure deletion) anchor at a region's end line no longer overlaps that region; an edit there flips from rung 1 to rung 2
an insertion at a region's first line is no longer attributed to that region; it falls through to the last region, changing which region name and rung the edit reports
all->any: an edit spanning one anchored region and one unanchored region is classified rung 1 instead of rung 2
neighbour/non-neighbour rungs swapped: an edit to a covered neighbour needs 4 and an edit elsewhere needs 3
one-sided inserts and deletes no longer count as anchors; an edit inside a region whose only anchor was an insertion becomes rung 2
no-tools capture inverted: a non-empty diff block is treated as no change (candidate = mechanical, deep-empty) and an empty block is sent to _apply
verdict gate off-by-one: a variant whose edits needed exactly the allowed scope is rejected as deep-failed instead of staged
guarantees line: the '-- no tools: the model saw this file and the two diffs only' suffix appears when tools were on and is missing when they were off
dropped .lower() on the reason's region: a reason whose region differs only in case no longer matches the edit, so the report shows '(no reason given)'
removed guard: endswith('') is always true, so a reason with no path is attached to every edit whose region did not match
deep-proposed edit lines name the path instead of the region for in-payload edits
deep-escaped no longer takes the NOT KEPT branch: its error, reports and 'changed outside the sandbox' lines are not printed
